notes.title: BEER RUNNER (free game)
notes.notes:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2994250/Beer_Runner/

Jump, run, and climb over obstacles to deliver the keg of beer. Solve easy puzzles to progress further in the cyberpunk city. In each level, you'll discover new abilities like double jump, teleportation, etc.

Every WHISLIST save the beer!

notes.title: Rogue - like mode!
notes.notes:
After months of development I m almost done. Last feature "roguelike mode" is availible to play. 

Game is missing only music for new levels Forest and Ice world and fix the bugs. But it is not all, I plan add some new patches in 2024.

notes.title: Big update, story mode is complete.
notes.notes:
Finally, I released a new patch 1.11, which includes three new levels and three new enemies, including a final boss. Enjoy the game and save the 'wolf souls' world.
You can look forward to an icy world among rocks, ice, and piles of snow.
